_about: MR-RATE-style structured finding taxonomy for the 2D CT image-read pass (S2). A VLM derives these from the IMAGE (no source text). Tumor-progression-focused subset spanning the abdominal/thoracic oncology datasets (liver/kidney/pancreas/lung). SNOMED/RadLex codes left null on purpose — map them from a controlled vocabulary rather than fabricating. All findings are read on CT (primary_seq = 'ct').

labels.name: Target tumor (measurable lesion)
labels.desc: The dominant solid organ tumor being followed (liver/kidney/pancreas/lung mass).

labels.name: New lesion
labels.desc: Lesion not present on the prior scan (same organ or adjacent).

labels.name: New distant metastasis
labels.desc: New lesion remote from the primary site (liver/lung/peritoneal/bone).

labels.name: Lymphadenopathy
labels.desc: Enlarged regional or distant lymph nodes (short axis > 1 cm).

labels.name: Intratumoral necrosis
labels.desc: Central low-attenuation non-enhancing necrotic core (incl. post-TACE).

labels.name: Intratumoral / peritumoral hemorrhage
labels.desc: High-attenuation blood products in or around the lesion.

labels.name: Vascular invasion / tumor thrombus
labels.desc: Tumor extension into a vessel (e.g. portal/renal vein tumor thrombus).

labels.name: Local organ invasion
labels.desc: Direct extension of the tumor into an adjacent organ/structure.

labels.name: Biliary / ductal dilatation
labels.desc: Dilated bile ducts or pancreatic duct from obstructing tumor.

labels.name: Pleural effusion
labels.desc: Fluid in the pleural space (lung/abdominal malignancy).

labels.name: Satellite / pulmonary nodule
labels.desc: Additional small nodule near the primary (esp. lung datasets).

labels.name: Atelectasis / post-obstructive collapse
labels.desc: Lung volume loss adjacent to a mass.

labels.name: Treatment-effect pattern
labels.desc: Post-therapy change (lipiodol/necrosis after TACE, devascularization) favoring treatment effect over viable tumor.

labels.name: Calcification
labels.desc: Calcified component within or at the lesion margin.

labels.name: Mass effect
labels.desc: Displacement/compression of adjacent organs or vessels by the tumor.
